sentences.zh: 到时候我们会联系你的。

sentences.en: We actually reached out to some fans to talk to you today.
sentences.zh: 其实我们今天联系了一些粉丝来和你交流。

sentences.en: And there were people who had so many questions.
sentences.zh: 他们有好多问题想问。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So we're going to include some of their questions with our questions.
sentences.zh: 所以我们打算把他们的一些问题和我们的问题结合起来。

sentences.en: Very good.
sentences.zh: 非常好。

sentences.en: I'm excited.
sentences.zh: 我很期待。

sentences.en: Well, to get started, Paul, how did you get involved with The Office?
sentences.zh: 那么，保罗，我们先从头聊起，你是怎么加入《办公室》剧组的？

sentences.en: It was my great agent at the time, Renee Kurtz, who was steering me towards it.
sentences.zh: 当时我那伟大的经纪人蕾妮·库尔茨一直在引导我接下这个项目。

sentences.en: And honestly, I was offered several years before the chance to, you know, the British office into a series.
sentences.zh: 老实说，几年前我就曾有机会把英版《办公室》改编成剧集。

sentences.en: And I was like, oh, forget it.
sentences.zh: 当时我想，算了吧。

sentences.en: There's no way you can do it.
sentences.zh: 这根本不可能成功。

sentences.en: It's too scary, you know, because it's such a great series.
sentences.zh: 太可怕了，因为原版剧集实在太棒了。

sentences.en: So, you know, I just didn't even take the bait.
sentences.zh: 所以，我当时根本没上钩。

sentences.en: But then when Greg did it, you know, I was really, you know, amazed by that.
sentences.zh: 但后来格雷格接手了，我真的感到非常惊讶。

sentences.en: And I actually, the funny thing is I was making a pilot at the same time that Greg did the pilot for The Office.
sentences.zh: 有趣的是，当时我正在拍一部试播集，正好和格雷格拍《办公室》试播集是同一时期。

sentences.en: And I remember we were both working at, like, some studio, and he was editing there.
sentences.zh: 我记得我们当时都在同一个制片厂工作，他在那里剪辑。

sentences.en: And I remember him coming over to us, to Rodney Rothman and I, whose pilot it was.
sentences.zh: 我记得他走过来找我和罗德尼·罗斯曼，那是我们的试播集。

sentences.en: And he's like, hey, come in here, come in here.
sentences.zh: 他说，嘿，快进来，快进来。

sentences.en: I've got to play you a couple of different options for the opening theme song for this show that I just directed.
sentences.zh: 我得给你们放几个我刚执导的这部剧的片头曲选项。

sentences.en: And so he played a couple of different versions, including, you know, the one that the now infamous piano one.
sentences.zh: 于是他放了几个不同的版本，包括那个现在家喻户晓的钢琴版。

sentences.en: So I was definitely there right at the very beginning.
sentences.zh: 所以我绝对是在最开始的时候就在场了。

sentences.en: And, you know, when the show got picked up, my agent called me, Renee, and she was just like, you know, they'd like you to direct an episode.
sentences.zh: 后来剧集被预订了，我的经纪人蕾妮打电话给我，说他们想让我执导一集。

sentences.en: And so I watched the first six that you guys had done and thought they were so hilarious.
sentences.zh: 于是我看了你们拍的前六集，觉得太搞笑了。

sentences.en: You know, as soon as I saw Diversity Day, I was just, like, completely in.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我一看完《多元化日》那一集，就彻底入坑了。

sentences.en: I just thought it was so great.
sentences.zh: 我觉得它简直太棒了。

sentences.en: Yeah, I came to that first table read.
sentences.zh: 没错，我参加了第一次剧本围读。

sentences.en: I don't know if you remember, they did kind of a bunch of episodes all at once.
sentences.zh: 我不确定你还记不记得，当时他们一下子读了好几集剧本。

sentences.en: And I remember you guys were reading the Dundies and all that.
sentences.zh: 我记得你们当时在读《邓迪奖》那一集，还有其他那些。

sentences.en: And then we read Office Olympics.
sentences.zh: 然后我们读了《办公室奥运会》那一集。

sentences.en: And so I was in.
sentences.zh: 所以我就加入了。

sentences.en: Did you get to pick Office Olympics from that table read?
sentences.zh: 你是从那次围读中选了《办公室奥运会》吗？

sentences.en: Or was it assigned to you?
sentences.zh: 还是那是分配给你的？

sentences.en: Yeah, that was the one that was assigned to me.
sentences.zh: 对，那是分配给我的那一集。

sentences.en: Because I remember having a moment going like, oh, I want to do the Dundies.
sentences.zh: 因为我记得当时心里想，噢，我想拍《邓迪奖》那一集。

sentences.en: That seems really fun.
sentences.zh: 那看起来真的很有趣。

sentences.en: But then I just saw the potential of the Office Olympics was just going to be such a blaSt.
sentences.zh: 但后来我看到了《办公室奥运会》的潜力，觉得拍起来一定会非常过瘾。

sentences.en: I mean, it was just such a fun thing to kind of put together.
sentences.zh: 我是说，把那集内容整合起来真的很有意思。

sentences.en: You know, I remember just what an interesting, I don't know, what an interesting feeling it was on the set for that.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我记得当时在片场的感觉有多奇妙，怎么说呢，那种感觉真的很特别。

sentences.en: Because, I mean, if you remember, that was sort of, you know, aside from the Olympics part of it, that was the episode that kind of started to turn everything.
sentences.zh: 因为，如果你还记得的话，除了奥运会的部分，那一集其实是让一切开始发生转变的关键。

sentences.en: Because that's where, you know, Steve's character started to become slightly more sympathetic.
sentences.zh: 因为就在那一集，史蒂夫的角色开始变得稍微更讨人喜欢了一些。

sentences.en: And I don't know if you remember or not.
sentences.zh: 我不确定你还记不记得。

sentences.en: We really, that kind of got found on the set.
sentences.zh: 我们真的是在片场现场发掘出这一点的。

sentences.en: Because remember, we were doing the whole thing where we were presenting, you guys were presenting Michael with the, you know, with the medal.
sentences.zh: 因为记得吗，我们当时在拍那场戏，你们在给迈克尔颁发奖牌。

sentences.en: And Steve just made this decision to kind of start crying.
sentences.zh: 史蒂夫突然决定要开始哭。

sentences.en: You know, getting all choked up.
sentences.zh: 你知道，变得哽咽起来。

sentences.en: And I remember just going like, oh, my God, Steve, that's so great.
sentences.zh: 我记得当时我就想，天哪，史蒂夫，这太棒了。

sentences.en: Like, keep going with that.
sentences.zh: 就这样，继续保持那种感觉。

sentences.en: And that was, I think that was kind of the turning point where his character took that left turn from Ricky Gervais' character and became more sort of the lovable, you know,
sentences.zh: 我想那是一个转折点，他的角色从瑞奇·热维斯（Ricky Gervais）那种风格转了个弯，变得更像是一个……

sentences.en: misfit who's trying too hard for everybody to like him.
sentences.zh: 一个努力想让大家都喜欢他的可爱怪人。

sentences.en: But also, Paul, I remember in that filming of that scene that you directed all of us to be genuine.
sentences.zh: 但保罗，我也记得在拍那场戏时，你指导我们所有人要表现得真诚。

sentences.en: And you can see it on our faces that we are genuinely clapping for Michael.
sentences.zh: 你可以从我们的脸上看出来，我们是在真心实意地为迈克尔鼓掌。

sentences.en: We're not mocking him.
sentences.zh: 我们不是在嘲笑他。

sentences.en: It was this collective moment with everyone in the office enjoying supporting one another.
sentences.zh: 那是办公室里每个人都在享受互相支持的集体时刻。

sentences.en: It was really sweet.
sentences.zh: 真的很温馨。

sentences.en: It makes me tear up every time I watch it.
sentences.zh: 每次看那一幕我都会热泪盈眶。

sentences.en: I cried when Steve did that.
sentences.zh: 史蒂夫那样做的时候我也哭了。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: No, it really gets me, too.
sentences.zh: 不，那一幕真的也让我很感动。

sentences.en: Because I think, you know what it was?
sentences.zh: 因为我觉得，你知道那是为什么吗？

sentences.en: It was just Steve's performance was so sincere that it felt, if we were kind of being snarky or, you know, laughing at him, that it made you guys such villains to do that.
sentences.zh: 是因为史蒂夫的表演太真诚了，如果我们当时表现得尖酸刻薄或者嘲笑他，那会让你们看起来像个反派。

sentences.en: But it wasn't anybody's really instinct to do that.
sentences.zh: 但其实没人有那种本能去那样做。

sentences.en: And so I just kind of encourage you to go along with what you were already doing, which is we were all really being affected by Steve.
sentences.zh: 所以我只是鼓励你们顺着你们已经在做的事情演下去，那就是我们所有人都真的被史蒂夫打动了。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: It still gets me.
sentences.zh: 现在看还是会让我感动。

sentences.en: Well, we have a fan question for you.
sentences.zh: 好了，我们有一个粉丝提问给你。

sentences.en: Reed wrote in and said, I know.
sentences.zh: 里德（Reed）写信来说，我知道。

sentences.en: Oh, ooh.
sentences.zh: 噢，喔。

sentences.en: Reed says, when filming a mockumentary, do you storyboard or do you have a shot plan?
sentences.zh: 里德问：在拍摄伪纪录片时，你们会做分镜脚本或者拍摄计划吗？

sentences.en: Neither.
sentences.zh: 都不会。

sentences.en: What you do is go through the script.
sentences.zh: 你要做的是先过一遍剧本。

sentences.en: And I would walk around with Kelly, our AD, you know, the day before or whatever.
sentences.zh: 然后我会和我们的副导演凯利（Kelly）一起走一遍，你知道，就在拍摄前一天或者什么时候。

sentences.en: And we just basically kind of go, okay, what's the bet?
sentences.zh: 我们基本上就是商量，好吧，最好的方案是什么？

sentences.en: Where would we put the cameras for this scene so that we would be cross-shooting it and the cameras could where the documentary crew would actually be?
sentences.zh: 我们应该把摄像机放在哪里拍这场戏，这样我们才能进行交叉拍摄，而且摄像机的位置要符合纪录片摄制组实际会在的地方。

sentences.en: Like, okay, you know, for me, it's like I always wanted to have depth behind us, so I never wanted to shoot in the walls whenever I could avoid it.
sentences.zh: 怎么说呢，你知道，对我来说，我总是希望背景有深度，所以只要能避免，我就不想对着墙壁拍摄。

sentences.en: And so just kind of go, okay, they would be, you know, one would be over here by this desk and then on the opposite side, something, you know,
sentences.zh: 所以我会想，好吧，他们应该，你知道，一个人在这边桌子旁，然后在对面，某种程度上，你知道，

sentences.en: Matt would be over there and Randall would be on the other side.
sentences.zh: 马特在那边，兰德尔在另一边。

sentences.en: And really, that was kind of it.
sentences.zh: 真的，差不多就是这样。

sentences.en: Then you'd also go, like, okay, is this going to be a spy shot where you guys don't know you're on camera?
sentences.zh: 然后你还会想，好吧，这会是一个偷拍视角吗？就是你们不知道自己在镜头里那种？

sentences.en: We'll crack in the door.
sentences.zh: 我们会从门缝里拍。

sentences.en: And then that was kind of it.
sentences.zh: 然后差不多就是这样。

sentences.en: And then we would just give you comedy because just every time we shot the scene, this time, we already had.
sentences.zh: 接着我们就会给你们提供喜剧效果，因为每次我们拍这场戏时，这次，我们已经拍过了。

sentences.en: And then we had the confidence to keep that stuff in because I'd worked on other shows where probing or tagging something or just kind of taking a little left turn in the middle of the scene.
sentences.zh: 我们有信心保留那些内容，因为我曾在其他节目工作过，那里如果有人即兴发挥、加戏，或者在戏中间稍微转个弯，

sentences.en: But the showrunners just wouldn't put it in because they were so in love with their scripts that they just wouldn't use it.
sentences.zh: 但节目统筹就是不肯放进去，因为他们太爱自己的剧本了，所以根本不用。

sentences.en: But the shining example of that was when we did the next episode, the Halloween episode, where we had, you know, playing the emperor and talking to Michael and kind of goading him.
sentences.zh: 但最典型的例子就是我们拍下一集，万圣节那一集的时候，我们有，你知道，扮演皇帝，跟迈克尔说话，还挑逗他。

sentences.en: And we just found that funny angle that looked like the emperor from Star Wars where you just kind of see his face.
sentences.zh: 我们找到了那个有趣的视角，看起来就像《星球大战》里的皇帝，你只能看到他的脸。

sentences.en: And we just, you know, him just taunt it.
sentences.zh: 我们只是，你知道，让他一直挑衅。

sentences.en: And that went on and on.
sentences.zh: 那段戏持续了很久。

sentences.en: But Greg, I think, jettisoned some other kind of storyline just so we could keep that scene long because it was just so funny.
sentences.zh: 但我觉得格雷格舍弃了其他一些剧情线，就是为了让我们保留那场长戏，因为它实在太搞笑了。

sentences.en: And, you know, that takes a lot of confidence and sort of, you know, well, self-confidence really on the part of the showrunner to let those.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这需要很大的自信，某种程度上，嗯，节目统筹真的需要有自信才能允许这些存在。

sentences.en: I love that.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢那样。

sentences.en: Me too.
sentences.zh: 我也是。

sentences.en: I love hearing everything that went into how it ended up on screen.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢听关于最终呈现效果背后的所有故事。

sentences.en: We were just acting.
sentences.zh: 我们只是在演戏。

sentences.en: You did all this planning.
sentences.zh: 你们做了所有的规划。

sentences.en: I know.
sentences.zh: 我知道。

sentences.en: You put all this thought into it.
sentences.zh: 你们投入了这么多心思。

sentences.en: Without you, we are nothing.
sentences.zh: 没有你们，我们什么都不是。

sentences.en: Without you, we are nothing.
sentences.zh: 没有你们，我们什么都不是。

sentences.en: I'm wondering if you can talk a little bit about picking the condo location.
sentences.zh: 我想问问你能不能谈谈挑选公寓外景的事。

sentences.en: In this episode, because it's almost like another character it features so prominently.
sentences.zh: 在这一集中，它几乎像另一个角色一样，占据了非常显眼的位置。

sentences.en: What was the criteria for picking the condo?
sentences.zh: 挑选公寓的标准是什么？

sentences.en: You wanted something that had enough flow to it and openness that you weren't going to be stuck in little rooms, you know, with just basically walls as your background.
sentences.zh: 你想要那种有足够的流动性和开放感的地方，这样你就不会被困在小房间里，你知道，背景基本上只有墙壁。

sentences.en: And so what I really liked about it is it had that kitchen that went through to the back patio.
sentences.zh: 所以我真正喜欢它的一点是，它有一个通往后院露台的厨房。

sentences.en: So, you know, we were in the kitchen shooting Michael, kind of having his breakdown, which is still possibly, I think, the hardest I think I've ever laughed on a set.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，我们在厨房拍迈克尔，他当时有点崩溃，那可能是我在片场笑得最厉害的一次，我想。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: We were – when Steve was having that thing where he was having the breakdown, he kind of puts his hand on the stove and picks up the thing and then goes outside.
sentences.zh: 我们当时——当史蒂夫在演那场崩溃的戏时，他把手放在炉子上，拿起那个东西，然后走到外面。

sentences.en: Is this supposed to come off?
sentences.zh: 这东西是能拿下来的吗？

sentences.en: And he walks out with it.
sentences.zh: 然后他就拿着它走出去了。

sentences.en: I mean, that is like just – that's the genius of Steve.
sentences.zh: 我是说，那简直就是——这就是史蒂夫的天才之处。

sentences.en: I literally thought I was going to die when he was doing it.
sentences.zh: 他演的时候，我真的以为我要笑死了。

sentences.en: And every time we do a take, he would do something different.
sentences.zh: 而且每次我们重拍，他都会做点不一样的动作。

sentences.en: Did we use that same condo in dinner party?
sentences.zh: 我们在《晚宴》那一集里用了同一个公寓吗？

sentences.en: Did we manage to keep that same place?
sentences.zh: 我们设法保留了同一个地方吗？

sentences.en: It looked very familiar to me, didn't it, to you?
sentences.zh: 它对我来说看起来很眼熟，对你来说也是吧？

sentences.en: Like the kitchen.
sentences.zh: 就像厨房一样。

sentences.en: I thought it was the condo.
sentences.zh: 我以为那就是那个公寓。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: That's amazing.
sentences.zh: 太神奇了。

sentences.en: Well, what was fun about that is being able to go in and turn it into Jan's place.
sentences.zh: 嗯，有趣的是能够进去把它变成简的家。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: And that was – I mean, I don't want to jump episodes, but I mean, for dinner party,
sentences.zh: 那真是——我是说，我不想跳过剧集，但我是说，对于《晚宴》那一集，

sentences.en: that was the most fun of like how do we see how Jan's woman's touch went in with kimonos on the wall and that kind of stuff.
sentences.zh: 最有趣的就是我们如何展现简的女性品味，比如墙上的和服之类的东西。

sentences.en: Oh, my gosh.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: Paul, you have to come back.
sentences.zh: 保罗，你得回来。

sentences.en: You have to come in.
sentences.zh: 你得进来。

sentences.en: We will have so much fun with that.
sentences.zh: 我们会玩得很开心的。

sentences.en: I was talking to Mike Schur about this episode.
sentences.zh: 我曾和迈克·舒尔聊过这一集。

sentences.en: He was the writer of this episode, and he shared with us your choice of using a wide-angle lens when filming Steve for this episode.
sentences.zh: 他是这一集的编剧，他跟我们分享了你在拍摄史蒂夫时选择使用广角镜头的想法。

sentences.en: Can you talk a little bit about that?
sentences.zh: 你能谈谈那个吗？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: It was just – we really wanted him to feel loving because it's so much about him being overwhelmed.
sentences.zh: 当时就是……我们真的很想让他感受到那种爱，因为这一集很大程度上是在讲他如何感到不知所措。

sentences.en: I had a very similar experience when I first met Lori, my wife, and we were going to move in together.
sentences.zh: 我第一次见到我妻子洛丽时也有过类似的经历，当时我们打算搬到一起住。

sentences.en: And she had found this place.
sentences.zh: 她找好了房子。

sentences.en: And I came over.
sentences.zh: 我过去看了看。

sentences.en: It was under the guise.
sentences.zh: 那是借口。

sentences.en: I was just going to like look at it and see what it was about.
sentences.zh: 我本来只是想去看看，了解一下情况。

sentences.en: And little did I know, she kind of had the realtor there and everything.
sentences.zh: 但我没想到，她居然把房产中介什么的都叫在那儿了。

sentences.en: And like I had to sign the papers to pull the trigger.
sentences.zh: 我不得不当场签字拍板。

sentences.en: So suddenly I went from being like this kind of weird, lonely bachelor to like committing to moving in in front of all these people.
sentences.zh: 于是我突然从一个古怪、孤独的单身汉，变成了在众人面前承诺要搬进去住的人。

sentences.en: And I just kind of freaked out.
sentences.zh: 我当时有点被吓到了。

sentences.en: And I just remember that feeling of like suddenly the house felt very like abstract and like you're in a horror movie a little bit.
sentences.zh: 我记得那种感觉，房子突然变得很抽象，就像身处恐怖电影里一样。

sentences.en: You're having a panic attack.
sentences.zh: 你当时在恐慌发作。

sentences.en: And so I wanted Steve to kind of feel that being, you know, in that house of like it's almost like, you know, I forget there's an old movie, not Obsession,
sentences.zh: 所以我希望史蒂夫能有那种感觉，你知道，在那栋房子里，就像……我不记得是哪部老电影了，不是《痴迷》，

sentences.en: but something where this woman's going crazy in this house.
